message: So, the other day I was cooking dinner and I caught myself checking the smoke alarm for the third time—yes, the third! 😅 You’d think I was about to host a Michelin-star event instead of just making spaghetti. But hey, better safe than sorry, right? Having a plan for fire safety really does give me peace of mind, and I’m all for being the gloriously over-prepared person in my circle. Anyone else have a funny over-prepared moment?
